No synchronized farewell. [locked-decision-check PASS] decision:daiyu:death-direction (LOCKED, MUST; claim backed by 脂批 src:jimao:ch18) requires only that Daiyu dies as a long-illness endpoint; text has 贵妃丧后，黛玉的病一层层沉了下去 and a day of ordinary decline, no single-cause (no marriage/lost-jade/poverty cause). Character facts consistent with front-80 (Zijuan, Xueyan as Daiyu's maids; Li Wan as 大奶奶; Wang Furen). No BLOCKING contradiction found. [no-mass-wailing PASS] After death the first sequence is material: 取盆和干净绢子来, 取些衣物来, 婆子来问后事; weeping is individual and brief (紫鹃正用帕子掩住口), no chorus of wailing or last words, matching m6 forbidden_drift 不得全员围哭一口声. [advisory-observations PASS] Non-blocking observations only: (1) Baoyu says 药还没吃, though earlier 勉强咽了 shows Daiyu took a few sips; he did not see it, and 大半盏 remains, so it works as a misread. (2) 今儿早起她还说药苦 is an anchor line whose referent (a morning remark) is not shown on stage; the chapter gives only a grimace. Locked by P-Lock, so only noted. (3) Li Wan addresses Baoyu as 二叔; plausible kinship usage but I did not verify against front-80 forms of address (WARNING-grade at most). (4) Baoyu's elapsed time between hearing the news and arriving is long (he arrives after Wang Furen and after the lamp is lit) and is carried only by the relay chain and his hesitation; acceptable under the card's 信息链 requirement.
